# A pack whose only corpus is tests/yomitan.tsv

A fixture for `tests/conformance_refuses_test.cmake`: everything conforms
except that a pack with transforms needs `tests/corpus.tsv`, and only the
Japanese pack may use `tests/yomitan.tsv` as its corpus (docs/languages.md,
section 12.1 step 4).
